purpose: Canonical semantic and technical reference for the next NeuroScape planner migration. This file is intentionally NOT a drop-in replacement for the current runtime audio_library.json.
authoring_principles: Descriptions, labels, semantic tags, spatial character, and technical playback facts are canonicalized here.
Semantic appropriateness is intentionally not encoded as weighted use_when/avoid_when rules.
priority, selection_weight, use_when, avoid_when, suddenness, and intensity are intentionally excluded from this semantic migration file.
Scene/location compatibility is moved to scene_graph_v1.json rather than duplicated as per-asset ranking policy.
Technical safety and playback facts remain available under technical_contract and hard_dependencies.
Later Decision 2 prompts should receive a compact projection of this file, not the full technical contract for every candidate.
migration_notes: Both ocean_waves and ocean_waves_soft_01 are retained because they are present in different current sources; do not collapse them automatically until the team confirms whether they are distinct recordings.
forest_stream_ambient_bed_01 exists in the current branch runtime library but not the latest reviewed editor; it is retained so the migration does not silently drop a currently executable asset.

city-park assets and stream_lakeside_river exist in the latest editor/expanded library but are not yet supported by the current branch scene type/graph; they are included here for the upcoming architecture update.
forest_water_drop_far_01 keeps its legacy asset_id but is semantically corrected to a waterfall based on the user-confirmed identity of the recording.

assets.label: Distant Boat Horn
assets.description: A very distant soft boat horn that creates a sense of far horizon and open space.

assets.label: Slow Breathing
assets.description: A quiet slow inhale and exhale sound for grounding and meditation settling.

assets.label: Distant Children Playing
assets.description: Very distant and soft children playing, used rarely as a subtle beach life cue when the user is stable.

assets.label: Dog
assets.description: A brief dog bark heard at a distance in a city-park environment, adding a sparse sign of nearby everyday life.

assets.label: Light Street Ambience
assets.description: A light urban street ambience close to a park, with passing cars forming a broad, continuous background layer.

assets.label: Walk on the Street
assets.description: Slow, rhythmic footsteps of a person walking on a paved street, isolated from background traffic or other environmental noise.

assets.label: Forest Ambient Bed 01
assets.description: A soft and quiet forest ambience bed for creating an enclosed, calm, and protected atmosphere.

assets.label: Forest Ambient Bed 02
assets.description: An alternate quiet forest ambience bed for variation, maintaining a calm and stable forest atmosphere.

assets.label: Distant Forest Bird
assets.description: A soft distant bird call that gently brings attention back without disrupting the meditation.

assets.label: High Distant Forest Bird
assets.description: A soft but slightly higher-pitched distant bird call, used as a gentle attention cue in the forest scene.

assets.label: Slow Barefoot Creek Steps
assets.description: A sparse eight-second sequence of very slow barefoot steps alternating across damp creek-bank ground and a thin layer of shallow water, with long pauses and delicate wet contacts for embodied grounding.

assets.label: Soft Grass Footstep
assets.description: Slow and soft footsteps on grass, creating a gentle embodied presence inside the forest.

assets.label: Distant Insect Chirp
assets.description: A seven-second cluster of bright, sustained insect chirps from a fixed distant point, used sparingly as a high-frequency forest-life cue.

assets.label: Middle Distance Leaf Rustle
assets.description: A quiet leaf rustle in the middle distance, adding subtle life and spatial presence to the forest.

assets.label: Distant Small Animal Rustle
assets.description: A quiet six-second sequence of fine, irregular undergrowth rustles suggesting a small animal moving intermittently through dry leaves at a distance.

assets.label: Soft Distant Owl
assets.description: A single low-pitched distant owl hoot centered within a quiet five-second clip, used rarely to add nocturnal depth without crowding the soundscape.

assets.label: Quiet Forest Stream
assets.description: A very quiet twenty-second forest-stream bed with subdued, slow water movement and gentle irregular ripples, providing a calm creek presence without dominating the wider forest ambience.

assets.label: Distant Forest Waterfall
assets.description: A continuous distant waterfall recording that creates a clear directional freshwater landmark within the forest environment. It should be understood semantically as a waterfall, not as an isolated water-drop sound.
assets.semantic_revision_note: User-confirmed semantic correction: the underlying audio is a waterfall. The legacy asset_id is retained for compatibility.

assets.label: Wind Through Leaves
assets.description: Gentle wind moving through leaves, adding soft enclosure and spatial texture to the forest scene.

assets.label: Distant Child Sand Play
assets.description: A distant quiet child playing with sand, adding a soft human beach-life cue without voices.

assets.label: Pebble Wash
assets.description: A gentle small wave washing over pebbles, adding delicate beach texture without becoming loud.

assets.label: Soft Sea Breeze
assets.description: A soft sea breeze that creates an open, expansive, and calm beach atmosphere.

assets.label: Distant Seagull
assets.description: A soft distant seagull call that adds a gentle sense of life to the beach scene.

assets.label: Distant Shorebird
assets.description: Soft distant shorebird calls that add gentle coastal wildlife presence.

assets.label: Shoreline Wash
assets.description: Gentle water washing over sand, providing a slow rhythmic texture for calm breathing.

assets.label: Ocean Waves
assets.description: Ambient sound of a beach. Gentle waves rolling onto the shore with soft, natural variation, accompanied by a light coastal breeze. Occasional distant seagulls and faint echoes of water meeting rocks further away. The atmosphere feels calm, open, and immersive, as if standing at the edge of the shoreline. Subtle changes in the rhythm and intensity of the waves and wind to keep the sound natural and realistic, not repetitive.

assets.label: Soft Ocean Waves
assets.description: Soft ocean waves forming the main calm ambient bed of the beach scene.

assets.label: Wet Sand Footstep
assets.description: Slow soft footsteps on wet sand, creating a calm first-person beach presence.

assets.label: Lakeside River
assets.description: A calm, wide lakeside-river soundscape with soft shallow freshwater movement in the foreground and a quiet continuous river flow in the background. The current is smooth and steady, with no rapids, waterfall, splashes, rain, thunder, or ocean waves.
